usedFor: TagMango holds your course buyers and MailerLite holds your subscribers, so “Course Completion” runs “Create or Update Subscriber”.

bestTemplate.name: “Course Completion” in TagMango, then “Create or Update Subscriber” in MailerLite
bestTemplate.why: A learner who finishes a course is added or updated in MailerLite, ready for your next email.

watchOut: “Course Progress Event” also fires as people move through a course, so the same subscriber can update often.
